title: Children's Pencil Pouches Recalled by Raymond Geddes & Co. Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The paint on the pencil pouches' zipper pulls contains excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 84,200.

title: Children's Snow and Sand Castle Kits by Paricon Recalled Due to Sharp Edges; Sold Exclusively at LL Bean
summary: The largest plastic castle block maker in the kit could crack at the handle during use, creating sharp edges that can pose a laceration hazard to young children. Units: About 800.

title: Cooper Lighting Recalls Fluorescent Shop Lights Due to Electrical Shock Hazard
summary: When the two prongs on the plug’s electrical cord are touched simultaneously while lamps are installed, the light can pose an electric shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 274,000.

title: Discount School Supply Recalls Paint Brushes Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: Surface paint on the brush handles can contain excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 20,000.

title: Elmo USA Corp. Recalls Visual Presenters Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Improperly installed fluorescent top lights in the presenter can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 54,000.

title: Flashing Pacifiers Recalled By Sailing (U.S.) International Corp. Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The nipple can detach from the base, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 8,000.

title: La Femme NY Inc. Recalls Children's Necklace and Earring Sets Due to Risk of Lead Exposure
summary: The recalled jewelry contains high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: 4500.

title: Metal Jewelry Sold by Family Dollar Stores Recalled Due to Risk of Lead Exposure to Children
summary: The recalled jewelry contains high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 205,000.

title: Pure Allure Recalls Metal Jewelry Sold at Michaels Stores Due to Risk of Lead Exposure to Children
summary: The recalled metal jewelry contains high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 200,000.

title: Slipcovers Used With Boppy Pillows Recalled Due to Choking Hazard and Risk of Lead Exposure
summary: The zipper pull on the slipcovers can break, posing a choking hazard to young children. In addition, paint on the zippers contains excess levels of lead, which violates the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 38,000.

title: Children's Wooden Storage Rack Recalled By Jetmax International Following Child's Death
summary: The storage rack can tip over, posing an entrapment and suffocation hazard to young children. Units: About 36,000.

title: Hobby Lobby Stores Recalls Halloween-Themed Baskets Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: Surface paint on the bat, pumpkin and witch emblems attached to the baskets contain excess levels of lead, which violates the federal lead paint ban. Units: About 10,000.

title: Birch Bark Wrapped Candles Recalled by Roost Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The bark wrapping of the candle can ignite when the candle burns down, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,200.

title: Bon-Ton Recalls Children's Bath Robes Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The recalled bath robes fail to meet the children's sleepwear flammability standard, posing a risk of burn injuries to children if the robe caught fire. Units: About 1,000.

title: Iceberg Enterprises LLC Recalls Folding Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The plastic folding chairs can collapse during use, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 75,000.

title: Nike Recalls Football Helmet Chin Straps Which Can Break and Pose Risk of Serious Injury
summary: The chin strap's plastic cup can break as a result of contact, exposing the player to facial or head injuries. Units: About 235,000.

title: American Greetings Corp. Recalls Confetti Bursts Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The surface paint on the individual bags of confetti contains excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 60,000.

title: Lazy Lounger Chairs and Recliners Sold at Dick's Sporting Goods Recalled for Collapsing Hazard
summary: The plastic support brackets can break and cause the chairs to collapse, posing a hazard to consumers. Units: About 125,000.

title: Reeves International Inc. Recalls Holiday Ornaments Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: Surface paints on the ornaments contain high levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standards. Units: About 36,000.

title: Children's Full Zip Hooded Sweatshirts with Drawstrings Recalled for Strangulation Hazard By Bon-Ton
summary: The garments have a drawstring through the hood, which can pose a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 3,240.

title: Meijer Inc. Recalls Firepits; Product Can Tip Over and Pose a Fire Hazard
summary: The legs of the firepit can bend or snap off during use, causing the firepit to tip over and in turn the fire can escape. This poses a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 6,000.

title: Miter Saws Recalled by WMH Tool Group Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The saw handle's switch can fail, causing the saw to smoke, spark, and trip circuit breakers, and disable the safety brake. The saw also can keep operating unless the unit is unplugged, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 7,100.

title: Power Bolt Pitchbacks Sold at Dick's Sporting Goods Recalled Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The upper portion of the frame can collapse after both locking pins are removed, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 57,000.
